The third 1.5.0 beta fixes chunks the web map and **Trim unused chunks** couldn't read. On servers whose world came from somewhere else, such as an older install, region files the server wrote later could end up unreadable to the panel, and you'd see "chunks couldn't be read and were left out … Permission denied". Server folders now always pass the panel's group on to new files, and the agent puts a server's permissions right whenever it starts it from stopped. A restart from the panel now stops the server, repairs, then starts it again.

Existing boxes fix themselves the next time each server starts after updating. Testing notes are in [testing-1.5.0.md](https://github.com/teamflytower/flytower/blob/v1.5.0-beta.3/docs/testing/testing-1.5.0.md).
